docstring:
Is the sum $\sum\frac{1}{a_i}$ minimised when $G$ is a complete bipartite graph?

This problem is #65 in Extremal Graph Theory in the graphs problem collection.
references: [GKS84] Gyárfás, A., Komlós, J. and Szemerédi, E., On the distribution of cycle lengths in graphs. J. Graph Theory (1984), 441-462.
[GPSV85] Gyárfás, A., Prömel, H. J., Szemerédi, E. and Voigt, B., On the sum of the reciprocals of cycle lengths in sparse graphs. Combinatorica (1985), 41-52.
[LiMo20] Liu, H. and Montgomery, R., A solution to Erdős and Hajnal's odd cycle problem. arXiv:2010.15802 (2020).
type_pretty:
∀ (k : ℝ),
  0 < k →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
      0 < n →
        Fintype.card V = n →
          ↑G.edgeSet.ncard = k * ↑n →
            ∀ (A B : Type) [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B],
              Fintype.card (A ⊕ B) = n →
                ↑(completeBipartiteGraph A B).edgeSet.ncard = k * ↑n →
                  ∑ᶠ (a : ℕ) (_ : a ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph A B).cycleLengths), 1 / ↑a ≤
                    ∑ᶠ (a : ℕ) (_ : a ∈ G.cycleLengths), 1 / ↑a
